name: Component Security
definition: Security which forms a component of another security, for example, underlying.

SeparationChoice.name: Separation Choice
SeparationChoice.definition: Defines if the separation of the security is optional or mandatory.

QuantityNumerator.name: Quantity Numerator
QuantityNumerator.definition: Number of related securities for the exercise.

QuantityDenominator.name: Quantity Denominator
QuantityDenominator.definition: Number of held securities for the exercise.

SeparationDate.name: Separation Date
SeparationDate.definition: Date/time at which the related security can (optional) or must (mandatory) be separated.

SeparationPeriod.name: Separation Period
SeparationPeriod.definition: Period during which the related security can (optional) or must (mandatory) be separated.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Security for which a component security is specified.
